title: Friction Log To Rules
one_line: Turn the things that went wrong in a working session into standing rules that stop them recurring.
description: Turn the things that went wrong in a working session into standing rules that stop them recurring. Use at the end of a project, after a mistake, during a retrospective, or when the same problem keeps happening.
paragraph: Most retrospectives produce observations and no change, because an observation is not actionable and a rule is. This skill converts each friction point into a rule with a trigger, an action and a place it lives, and discards the ones that cannot be written that way, because a rule nobody can apply is noise in the rule set.
